title: Relationship Reserve on Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Reinstatements — Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Accounts
content:
A discretionary reinstatement of a Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Installment Sale Contract carries a relationship reserve that follows the customer's Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Installment Sale Contract. Where the customer holds more than one active Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Installment Sale Contract, the first one the retail lookup lists is the one read: its days past due and its own past-due amount.

| The active Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Installment Sale Contract read | Relationship reserve |
|---|---|
| At least 15 days (the full-reserve days) but fewer than 30 days (the relationship limit) past due | half of one monthly installment of the pre-owned contract, rounded to the cent, plus that retail contract's own past-due amount |
| Past due by fewer than 15 days (1 to 14 days) | half of one monthly installment of the pre-owned contract, rounded to the cent |
| 30 days or more past due | none |
| Not past due, or no active retail contract | none |
| Any — a reinstatement the state reinstatement period grants | none |

### Hypothetical figures (pre-owned monthly installment $415.50)

| Retail contract | Reserve |
|---|---|
| 20 days past due, past-due amount $560.00 | $207.75 (half of $415.50) plus $560.00: $767.75 |
| 15 days past due, past-due amount $560.00 | $767.75 |
| 14 days past due | $207.75 |
| 0 days past due | none |
